adjudication.rationale: The diff adds two new admin controllers with real behavior (Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#create/update/destroy plus save_host defaulting blank category_id to SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id and returning render_json_error on validation failure; Admin::EmbeddingController#show/#update rendering EmbeddingSerializer). However, the only new controller specs (spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb and spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb) merely assert the superclass inheritance and do not exercise any controller actions, response codes/bodies, error branches, defaulting behavior, or serialization shape—so they can misleadingly suggest coverage where there is none.
